## SmartSpectraSDK

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk`.
Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/main`.

Vitals measurement entry point. Owns one processing pipeline and surfaces lifecycle events via `on()`. Lifecycle methods throw a JS `Error` on failure with numeric `code` (a `SmartSpectraErrorCode` value), `message`, and boolean `retryable` properties.

```ts
import { SmartSpectraSDK, PixelFormat, decodeMetrics } from '@smartspectra/node-sdk';
const sdk = new SmartSpectraSDK({ apiKey: 'YOUR_KEY' });
sdk.on('metrics', (buf, ts) => console.log(decodeMetrics(buf)));
sdk.useCustomInput();
sdk.start();
sdk.sendFrame(rgbBuf, width, height, stride, PixelFormat.kRGB, timestampUs);
await sdk.destroy();
```

- ```typescript
  waitUntilComplete(timeoutMs?: number): boolean
  ```

  Block until the session reaches a terminal state (idle or error), or the timeout elapses. Returns true if the session settled, false on timeout. `timeoutMs <= 0` (the default) waits indefinitely. Use after `useFile()` + `start()` to block until end-of-file.

- ```typescript
  destroy(): Promise<void>
  ```

  Tear down the session. Idempotent. Await before constructing a replacement session when teardown ordering matters, since native SDK state is process-global.

- ```typescript
  requestInsight(text: string): number
  ```

  Dispatch an on-demand insight prompt; returns the request id. The matching Insight response arrives asynchronously through the `'insight'` event with the same id.

- ```typescript
  useCustomInput(frameTransform?: FrameTransformValue): this
  ```

  Select the custom frame-push input source (push frames via `sendFrame()` after `start()`). Returns `this` for chaining; call before `start()`.

- ```typescript
  useCamera(selection: CameraSelection, options?: Omit<CameraOptions, 'deviceIndex'>): this
  ```

  Select a live camera as the input source. The SDK opens the camera and pumps frames internally on `start()` — no `sendFrame()` needed. Returns `this` for chaining. Captures in THIS process — for Electron, prefer the renderer SDK's `useMediaStream()`. Select while stopped; explicit requests never fall back. Selection is resolved at startup and retained across stop/start/reset. Invalid or busy requests preserve the previous source. Pass CameraSelection.default for SDK selection.

- ```typescript
  useCamera(options?: CameraOptions): this
  ```

  Select a camera by legacy index (default 0). Reset clears the source. @deprecated Pass an explicit CameraSelection and separate capture options instead.

- ```typescript
  useFile(videoPath: string, options?: VideoFileOptions): this
  ```

  Select a pre-recorded video file as the input source. `start()` begins playback (non-blocking, on SDK worker threads); use `waitUntilComplete()` or watch `'processingStatus'` for the idle transition to detect end-of-file. Returns `this` for chaining.

## SmartSpectraSDK (renderer)

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer`.

Renderer-side `SmartSpectraSDK` for Electron applications. By default the SDK acquires the host's front-facing camera at 1280x720 / 30 fps, locks AE/AWB/focus once the signal pipeline reports Running, and emits the active `MediaStream` through `'streamAvailable'` so the host can show a live preview. Host apps that need finer control (custom resolution, virtual cameras, `<canvas>.captureStream()`, etc.) call `useMediaStream()` before `start()` to override the default. Requires the preload script to expose the bridge — set `webPreferences.preload = require.resolve('@smartspectra/node-sdk/preload')` on the BrowserWindow, and call `bindSmartSpectraIpc(window)` from the main process.

```ts
import { SmartSpectraSDK } from '@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer';
import { breathingMetrics, cardioMetrics } from '@smartspectra/node-sdk';
const sdk = new SmartSpectraSDK({
apiKey: 'YOUR_KEY',
requestedMetrics: [...breathingMetrics, ...cardioMetrics],
});
sdk.on('streamAvailable', (stream) => {
document.querySelector('video').srcObject = stream;
});
sdk.on('metrics', (buf, ts) => { ... });
await sdk.start();  // SDK acquires the camera + emits 'streamAvailable'
```

### Initializers

- ```typescript
  constructor(options?: RendererSmartSpectraOptions)
  ```

### Methods

- ```typescript
  useMediaStream(stream: MediaStream, options?: MediaStreamOptions): this
  ```

  Override the default camera with a host-supplied `MediaStream` from `navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia`, `desktopCapturer`, a `<canvas>.captureStream()`, etc. Optional — if not called, `start()` acquires its own MediaStream with sensible defaults and emits it via the `'streamAvailable'` event. When the host supplies the stream the host also owns its lifecycle; the SDK never stops the original tracks. Throws an `Error` with `code` `kConfigurationFailed` when `options.frameTransform` is not a `FrameTransform` value.

- ```typescript
  start(): Promise<void>
  ```

  Begin processing. If no stream was provided via `useMediaStream()`, the SDK acquires the default front-facing camera (1280x720 / 30 fps) and emits it through `'streamAvailable'` so the host can attach a preview. Resolves once the main-process SDK is running.

- ```typescript
  stop(): Promise<void>
  ```

  Stop processing. Resolves once the main-process SDK reports idle. Releases any SDK-acquired camera; host-supplied streams are left untouched.

- ```typescript
  reset(): Promise<void>
  ```

  Rebuild the processing pipeline after a kError state. Releases any SDK-acquired camera so the next `start()` re-acquires from scratch.

- ```typescript
  requestInsight(text: string): Promise<number>
  ```

  Dispatch an on-demand insight prompt. Resolves with the request id assigned to it; the matching response arrives via the `'insight'` event with the same id.

- ```typescript
  destroy(): void
  ```

  Tear down renderer-side resources and instruct the main process to destroy its SDK instance. Idempotent.

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'processingStatus',   callback: (status: ProcessingStatusValue) => void): this
  ```

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'validationStatus',   callback: (code: ValidationCodeValue, timestampUs: number, hint: string) => void): this
  ```

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'metrics',            callback: (buf: Uint8Array, timestampUs: number) => void): this
  ```

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'accumulatedMetrics', callback: (buf: Uint8Array, timestampUs: number) => void): this
  ```

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'insight',            callback: (buf: Uint8Array, requestId: number) => void): this
  ```

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'frameSentThrough',   callback: (sent: boolean, timestampUs: number) => void): this

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'error',              callback: (code: SmartSpectraErrorCodeValue, message: string, retryable: boolean) => void): this

- ```typescript
  on(event: 'streamAvailable',    callback: (stream: MediaStream) => void): this
  ```

  Fires once the SDK has acquired (or re-acquired, after a Stop) the default `MediaStream`. Host apps attach this stream to their preview `<video>` element. Not fired when the host supplies its own stream via `useMediaStream()` — the host already owns that reference.

## SmartSpectraOptions

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk`.
Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer`.

Options passed to the SmartSpectra constructor.

```typescript
apiKey?: string
```

API key for server-validated auth.

```typescript
requestedMetrics?: number[]
```

MetricType integer codes. Defaults to `breathingMetrics` (`MetricType.CHEST_BREATHING`, `MetricType.ABDOMEN_BREATHING`, `MetricType.BREATHING_RATE`) when omitted. Requesting an Unavailable metric (`MetricType.BREATHING_AMPLITUDE`, `MetricType.APNEA`, `MetricType.RESPIRATORY_LINE_LENGTH`, `MetricType.BASELINE`, `MetricType.INHALE_EXHALE_RATIO`) makes `start()` throw `kConfigurationFailed`.

```typescript
enableAccumulatedOutput?: boolean
```

Also emit an accumulated metrics packet at the end of each session.

```typescript
logLevel?: SmartSpectraLogLevelValue
```

Verbosity of SDK logging, applied when the session initializes. Defaults to SmartSpectraLogLevel.kWarning (warnings and errors only).

```typescript
enableTelemetry?: boolean
```

Session summaries and full readiness reports. Defaults to `true`; set `false` to opt out. Reports can contain free text, paths and platform context, and authenticated requests can correlate them with an account/device. No raw frames or measured vitals are sent. See SDK Telemetry & Privacy.

## VideoFileOptions

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk`.

Playback options for useFile().

```typescript
timestampsPath?: string | null
```

Path to a per-frame timestamps file (one timestamp per line).

```typescript
interframeDelayMs?: number
```

Throttle between frames in ms; omit/0 = as fast as possible. The SDK measures frame rate from frame timestamps: the timestamp file when one is given, otherwise the video's playback position. The interframe delay changes playback speed, not the measured frame rate.

```typescript
startOffsetMs?: number
```

Seek this far into the file before playback (ms); omit/0 = start.

```typescript
maxDurationMs?: number
```

Stop after this much content (ms); omit/0 = no limit.

```typescript
frameTransform?: FrameTransformValue
```

Spatial transform applied to every frame.

## RendererSmartSpectraOptions

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer`.

Renderer constructor options: the shared SDK options plus a renderer-only IPC ack timeout. (`sendTimeoutMs` has no meaning for the main-process SDK, which doesn't go through the preload bridge.)

```typescript
interface RendererSmartSpectraOptions extends SmartSpectraOptions
```

```typescript
sendTimeoutMs?: number
```

Per-call timeout (ms) for renderer→main IPC roundtrips (start/stop/reset/requestInsight/configure). If the main process crashes or stalls, the pending call rejects with an `Error` whose `code` is `'SMARTSPECTRA_IPC_TIMEOUT'` instead of hanging the UI forever. Defaults to 30000; set to 0 to disable.

## MediaStreamOptions

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer`.

Options for `useMediaStream()`.

```typescript
frameTransform?: FrameTransformValue
```

Spatial transform the SDK applies to every frame before processing, e.g. `FrameTransform.kRotate90CW` for a camera mounted sideways. Takes effect on the next `start()`; the host's preview is not transformed. Defaults to `FrameTransform.kNone`; each `useMediaStream()` call replaces the previous transform.

## decodeMetrics (messages)()

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/messages`.

Decode a Metrics protobuf buffer emitted by the SDK's `metrics` or `accumulatedMetrics` events. Accepts Node's `Buffer`, browser-side `Uint8Array`, or raw `ArrayBuffer`.

`export declare function decodeMetrics(buf: Uint8Array \| ArrayBuffer): generatedPresage.smartspectra.Metrics`

## setMetricsClass()

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk`.

Register a protobuf Metrics class exposing `deserializeBinary(buf)` (google-protobuf) or `decode(buf)` (protobufjs). `decodeMetrics()` will use it; otherwise the raw Buffer is returned.

`export declare function setMetricsClass(cls: unknown): void`

## bindSmartSpectraIpc()

Import from `@smartspectra/node-sdk/main`.

Wires the per-window IPC channel that backs `@smartspectra/node-sdk/renderer`. Call once per `BrowserWindow` that hosts a renderer using the helper. The binding tracks the window via `'closed'` and releases its SDK + port when the window goes away, so apps don't need explicit teardown. One-time SDK initialization runs on the first call. Host apps don't manage it.

`export declare function bindSmartSpectraIpc(window: BrowserWindow, options?: BindSmartSpectraIpcOptions): void`
